payload.summary: Resolved the migration 035 fresh-deploy blocker and work-package context declarations. Fresh rootless Podman, asyncpg apply and retry, live PostgreSQL projection, smoke, ZAP baseline, and HTTP E2E all passed; unrelated architecture and legacy fresh-schema warnings remain documented.

decisions.title: Normalize explicit migration boundaries inside the runner
decisions.rationale: psql needs BEGIN and COMMIT for LOCK TABLE while asyncpg must retain ownership of the atomic migration and tracking transaction
